meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit to women: women's share of bank loans to individuals, by amount and by number of accounts, in every state, every quarter since March 2014
meta.note: RBI BSR-1 quarterly table 1.10 (DBIE 1555), district-wise and gender-wise credit to individuals, summed here to states and all India. Measures 1-2 are men's accounts and amounts, 3-4 women's, 5-6 the totals (checked: men + women = total). Credit to individuals only; loans to firms, including those women own, are not counted here.
